kills.property: For any uint56 changeFee input, after initialize(...) the contract's public changeFee equals the exact uint56 value passed in (i.e. stored unchanged); the mutant that increments the stored value by 1 will cause changeFee() != _changeFee for some fuzzed _changeFee inputs.
kills.change_summary: Assigns a different value to changeFee by swapping assignment to set changeFee to _changeFee + 1 instead of _changeFee.

kills.property: For any initialize(...) call, the contract's public baseToken getter returns the _baseToken argument passed to initialize; the mutant that assigns msg.sender instead breaks this by making baseToken equal to the caller rather than the provided _baseToken for some inputs.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning msg.sender instead of the provided _baseToken, changing stored baseToken after initialize.

kills.property: For any initialize(...) call that succeeds, the contract's public feeRate equals the _feeRate argument passed; the mutant that sets feeRate = 0 breaks this invariant for any non-zero _feeRate.
kills.change_summary: Replace the assignment to feeRate with zeroing it, so feeRate becomes 0 regardless of _feeRate.

kills.property: For every input to initialize(...), the deployed correct contract stores baseToken equal to the _baseToken argument; the mutant sets baseToken to address(0) instead, so for some fuzzed _baseToken the stored baseToken will differ from the passed-in argument.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning zero address instead of the provided _baseToken, causing baseToken to differ after initialize.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's stored feeRate equals the provided _feeRate (reference); the mutant increments the stored feeRate by 1, so there exist inputs where c.feeRate() != _feeRate causing the property to fail.
kills.change_summary: Replace the assignment to feeRate with assignment that adds 1 to the provided _feeRate (off-by-one), so feeRate becomes _feeRate + 1.

kills.property: For any valid initialize(...) call the contract's initialized getter becomes true after the call; the mutant (which omits setting initialized = true) will leave initialized as false for some inputs, so the property fails.
kills.change_summary: Remove the line that sets initialized = true so initialize does not mark the contract as initialized.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the deployed contract's public baseToken equals the provided _baseToken argument; the mutant assigns nft to baseToken so for some inputs baseToken != _baseToken and the property is violated.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to baseToken with assigning nft (swap), so baseToken is set to the provided NFT address after initialize.

kills.property: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's nft getter returns the _nft argument passed to initialize; the mutant assigns nft = msg.sender instead and thus for some inputs nft() != _nft.
kills.change_summary: Replace assignment to nft so initialize sets nft to msg.sender instead of the provided _nft parameter.
